integrity: The sharp lower bound and canonical boundary form have a direct integer-inequality proof. An independent verifier exhausts both labeled profiles and anonymous count vectors through five voters, using exact arithmetic and independent score implementations, and checks the candidate-relabeling orbit and multinomial recount.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes exactly three candidates and committee size two. The unique-winner boundary does not rule out smaller tie-level differences, and no claim is made for larger candidate sets or committee sizes. The conditional denominator 11970 is verified by exhaustive enumeration.
title: Five voters are the sharp unique-committee split between PAV and approval Chamberlin–Courant
